title: The Jewel Thief Who Swallowed $4 Million in Diamonds
hook: He walked out of the store with millions in gems inside his own stomach—and the body scanners couldn't find them.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme physical risk and a nearly impossible feat—body horror meets criminal ingenuity stuns viewers.

title: The Fraudster Who Sold Fake Snow to Ski Resorts for 10 Years
hook: He shipped truckloads of white powder that looked like snow—but was actually toxic waste. Skiers paid the price.
why_this_can_go_viral: Betrayal of winter sports paradise with hazardous chemicals is equal parts shocking and visually compelling.

title: The Mob Boss Who Controlled an Entire Prison from Inside a Cell
hook: From a 6x9 cell, he ran his empire with smuggled phones, coded letters, and a network of corrupt guards on payroll.
why_this_can_go_viral: Power dynamics flipped—the most guarded man in the world still runs the streets fascinates and frightens.
